name: TA / Recruiting Practitioner
lens: The recruiter/TA specialist who owns cost-per-hire reporting and needs a real, defensible number built from their own hard-cost and soft-cost line items instead of quoting the generic SHRM average.
why: This is an operational how-to-calculate piece with exact line-item benchmarks and a runnable build — the Recruiter row explicitly names cost-per-hire as their metric and calls for exact operational numbers plus a step list, while the Executive persona's cost angle is ROI of the buying decision, not building the metric itself.
